synopsis.en: During his night shift in Madrid, well-meaning paramedic Eduardo responds to an emergency call at the home of a criminal named Mario. Before dying, Mario forces Eduardo to take a highly coveted object, thrusting him into a desperate, high-stakes conflict involving rival criminal factions.
synopsis.es: Durante su turno de noche en Madrid, Eduardo, un paramédico bienintencionado, acude a una llamada de emergencia en la casa de un criminal llamado Mario. Antes de morir, Mario obliga a Eduardo a tomar un objeto muy codiciado, empujándolo a un conflicto desesperado de alto riesgo con facciones criminales rivales.
